Start here.How to get an AI keyA 2-minute walkthrough of grabbing a key from a popular provider and pasting it into Settings.Start your first chatFrom picking a character to your first reply — everything you need to begin in under 60 seconds.Tips for better roleplaySmall habits that make characters feel more alive: tone, pacing, and how to steer the story.FAQ✦Everything you might want to know before you start.Do I need to install anything?No. RoleChat AI runs entirely in your browser. There is nothing to download or install — just open the page and start chatting.Is my data private?Yes. Your API key and your conversations are stored locally in your browser. We do not run a server that reads your chats. You bring your own AI key, so your messages go directly between your browser and the AI provider you choose.What is an API key and where do I get one?An API key is a secret string that lets the app talk to an AI provider. You can get one from any OpenAI-compatible service. Paste it into Settings inside the app and you're ready.Can I use my own character cards?Yes. If you already have a character card (SillyTavern format), you can import it into the app. We're also building a library of original characters you can start with right away.Is RoleChat AI free?The app itself is free. You pay the AI provider you choose for the messages you generate, using your own key. There is no subscription and no middleman markup.Do I need to understand model settings?No. Sensible defaults are set for you. If you like, you can open the advanced options later — but you never have to in order to enjoy a great chat.Are there other tavern tools on this site?Yes. Besides the RoleChat AI web app, we feature PureTavern — a SillyTavern-compatible client you can self-host on any static hosting — SillyTavernMOD — a multi-user fork for running your own tavern site — and a directory of local tavern clients such as SillyTavern, RisuAI and AgnAI.Ready to start your story?✦Open the app, pick a character, and say hello.
